svg.aria-label: vardax on the GeoStack role ladder: cycles as recipes, every method as an analysis step, solve, train and validation algorithms, the analysis methods and their priors as models, minimisers and uncertainty readers as strategies, cost terms as primitives, and the data, observation operators and controls as structures; pipekit-cycle, optimistix and argminax sit beside the ladder.
